title: RestClientOptions
description: Configuration options for the RestSharp RestClient. Passed to the RestClient constructor to configure base URL, authentication, timeouts, redirects, and HTTP client behavior.

baseUrl.description: Base URL for all requests made by this client

authenticator.description: IAuthenticator implementation for request authentication (OAuth1, OAuth2, HTTP Basic, JWT Bearer)

timeout.description: Request timeout in milliseconds. 0 = no timeout (use with caution)

followRedirects.description: Whether to automatically follow HTTP redirects. Default: true

maxRedirects.description: Maximum number of redirects to follow

encoding.description: Default encoding for request and response content

preAuthenticate.description: Whether to send credentials with the first request. Default: false

useDefaultCredentials.description: Whether to use default system credentials. Default: false

disableCharset.description: Whether to omit charset from Content-Type header. Default: false

allowMultipleDefaultParametersWithSameNa.description: Whether to allow multiple default parameters with the same name. Default: false
